page.content:
Vast green nation of Ba Sing Se, Omashu, and earthbenders.

How Earth Kingdom connects

  • Location: Ba Sing Se — Ba Sing Se is the Earth Kingdom capital.
  • Character: Toph Beifong — Toph is an Earth Kingdom earthbender.

What is Earth Kingdom?

The Earth Kingdom is the largest nation, a continent of villages, Dai Li secrets, and Ba Sing Se's walls, where Toph invents metalbending.

Key threads lead to Ba Sing Se and Toph Beifong.
